description: Cases that expand.py and the site's campaign builder must both pass. A case's campaign is a file ("file", a path relative to experiments/), a file with a JSON merge patch applied ("from" and "patch", RFC 7386: objects merge, null removes a key, anything else replaces), or written out whole ("campaign"). "valid" is the expected outcome. Every string in "errors" and "warnings" must appear inside one of the messages produced; a valid case produces no errors, and a case produces exactly as many warnings as it lists. "runs", "waves", "too_big_for_quota" and "differs" (the fields whose values differ between specs) must match exactly; "expected_usd" and "worst_case_usd" to the cent. Waves are under limits.json's vCPU quota, or under the case's "quota" when it gives one.
